title: session.permission_denied
description: The session tried to use a tool its permission policy denied. It is an incident, not an outcome: the session goes on, and may be denied again. No parity in flowpilot — it is born with skill permission enforcement (D4).

resource.description: Which axis of the policy answered for the denial. The two axes are the ones the skill manifest declares in permissions.

tool.description: The entry that was denied, in the vocabulary the adapter passed to the engine: a name (WebFetch) or a name with a pattern (Bash(curl *)). It is engine vocabulary inside the log on purpose — without it the denial is not auditable.

reason.description: What the engine answered, when it answered anything legible. The denial is recognised by structural correlation, never by this text: prose changes with the version, the shape of the frame does not.
